feedback.keep: TTY terminal concept and pixel style
feedback.change: Original white and ice-blue palette disliked; explore four distinct colorways

candidates.name: PHOSPHOR
candidates.detail: Heading "09 / PHOSPHOR". Green monochromatic retro terminal palette. Outer frame, arms and feet medium leaf green #6DAA44; shadow clusters deep olive #34562C; screen nearly black green #101B12; > and underscore BOTH bright acid lime #C4F36B. Sparse highlight pixels pale yellowgreen #DDECB6. Green frame is bold and visible, not white. Crisp energetic phosphor feel with absolutely no bloom.
